g.text: Markers use station anchors; labels use leader lines. Curves separate coincident branch categories. Lines show model connections, not physical routes.

g.text: ≈ Dover: address-level approximation. † Northport: station-level anchor; model138kV / source115kV. Other original NPCC points are approximate model locations.
